/* cppi::b6edd9b9f6dafb47891981874b49a49070aec73f070dd4aeaf707f8a414be2ed */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 10
		AND hour between 21 and 22
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-10 21:01:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::e52152c1ee294d9ce22c08719ab8eb574b48d28e3608e595a0ee6221c7dff4b8 */
/* QuickSight */
SELECT ds.* FROM ( with lt_base as (
	select
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel1 as investment_structure_level_01,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2 as investment_structure_level_02,
		uppcc.epm_party_name as ultimate_parent_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name as issuer_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name /*as "Exposure Via"*/,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name,
		sum( lt.total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
	from (
		select *
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
		where
			id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
			and id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
				  'MIN1000042'
				, 'NPTESTA'
				, 'NPTESTB'
				, 'PMIEMELTCS'
				, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
				, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
				, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
			) 
			and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough ) -- filter only for the data as of the latest business date
	) lt
	left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite secc
	on
		lt.enterprise_security_id = secc.enterprise_security_id
		and lt.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite pcc
	on
		secc.enterprise_party_id = pcc.enterprise_party_id
		and pcc.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite uppcc
	on
		pcc.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id = uppcc.enterprise_party_id
		and uppcc.business_date = pcc.business_date
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
	on
		lt.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	group by
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel1,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2,
		uppcc.epm_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name
), lt_final as (
	select
		  *
		, ultimate_parent_party_name || ' | ' || issuer_name || ' | ' || security_name as combined_entity_name_original
		, ultimate_parent_party_name || ' | ' || issuer_name || ' | ' || security_name_clean as combined_entity_name_clean
		, case
			when investment_structure_level_01 in ( 'Cash for benefits', 'Accounts' ) then '7. Cash for Benefits and Residual Cash'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Total Fund Management' then '1. Total Fund Management'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' then '2. Capital Markets & Factor Investing'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Active Equities' then '3. Active Equities'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Credit Investments' then '4. Credit Investments'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Private Equity' then '5. Private Equity'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Real Assets' then '6. Real Assets'
	  	  end department_sorted
	from (
		select
			  *
			, case
				when regexp_like( lower( security_type_name ), '.*\b(leg|swap|swaption|option|future|contract|bond|repo|revrepo|buyselback|selbuyback)\b.*' ) then regexp_replace( security_name, '[0-9]', '' )
				else security_name
			  end security_name_clean
		from 
			lt_base
	)
)
select * from lt_final ) ds LIMIT 0

SELECT ds.* FROM ( with lt_base as (
	select
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel1 as investment_structure_level_01,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2 as investment_structure_level_02,

		lt.parent_security_type_name /*as "Exposure Via"*/,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name,
		sum( lt.total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
	from (
		select *
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough

	) lt

	on
		lt.enterprise_security_id = secc.enterprise_security_id
		and lt.business_date = secc.business_date

		and pcc.business_date = secc.business_date

	on

			, case

SELECT

            ROUND(case
                when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price
                else mid_price
                end,6) as mid_price,
            business_date
        FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
        WHERE
            from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD'
            and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
            and business_date = Date('2025-06-10')
        UNION
        Select
            MainTable.to_currency as from_currency,
            'CAD' as to_currency,
            ROUND(case
                when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then
                MainTable.mid_price * CAD_Rate.mid_price
                else (1/MainTable.mid_price) * CAD_Rate.mid_price
                end,6) as calc_mid_price,
            MainTable.business_date
        FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr as MainTable
        Left Join
        (
            SELECT
                case
                when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price
                else mid_price
                end as mid_price,
                business_date
            FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
            WHERE from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD' and business_date = Date('2025-06-10')

        ) as CAD_Rate on
            MainTable.business_date = CAD_Rate.business_date

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 10
		AND hour between 09 and 10
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-10 09:13:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

        ),
             adjusted_date AS (
                 SELECT
                     query_date,
                     CASE
                         WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 1 THEN query_date - interval '3' day
                         WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 7 THEN query_date - interval '1' day
                         ELSE query_date - interval '1' day
                         END AS business_date
                 FROM params
             ),
             account_mapping_query AS (
                 SELECT
                     date_format(pam.as_of_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
                     pam.mx_portfolio_id AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
                     pam.bbg_pfolio_id AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
                     pam.model_portfolio AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
                     pam.sst_account AS SST_ACCOUNT
                 FROM reference.model_portfolio_account_mapping pam
                 WHERE pam.as_of_date BETWEEN (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '7' day
                           AND (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '1' day
             ),
             unioned_data AS (
                 select COALESCE(BUSINESS_DATE, '') as BUSINESS_DATE,
                        COALESCE(TRIM(MUREX_PORTOFOLIO), '') as MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
                        COALESCE(TRIM(BBG_ACCOUNT), '') as BBG_ACCOUNT,
                        COALESCE(TRIM(SCD_ACCOUNT), '') as SCD_ACCOUNT,

  CASE

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- This query retrieves holdings data and joins it with coupon and security-level
-- metadata. It filters the results based on selected asset types and seniorities,
-- and enriches each record with maturity dates and expected exit information.
-- The data is sourced as-of the latest available business date for accurate and
-- timely reporting.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Acronyms:
-- - ABS   : Asset-Backed Security
-- - CLO   : Collateralized Loan Obligation
-- - CMBS  : Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities
-- - NPL   : Non-Performing Loan
-- - HRR   : High-Risk Rated
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Data Lineage Summary:
-- - Holdings Source:       holdings_uat.ci_sentry_holdings
--                          (CI Sentry - current holdings data)
-- - Security Metadata:     reference.ci_sentry_security
--                          (Reference - asset type, seniority, etc.)
-- - Coupon Metadata:       reference.ci_sentry_security_coupon
--                          (Reference - maturity dates and coupon terms)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Parameters:
-- - business_date     : Latest business date available in ci_sentry_holdings.
-- - asset_type filter : Hardcoded list of included asset types.
-- - seniority filter  : Hardcoded list of included seniorities.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.0.0 | 2025-04-09 | kbaxter@cppib.com
-- - Initial creation: joins holdings with security and coupon metadata, includes
--   filters for asset type and seniority, and applies latest business date.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.1.0 | 2025-04-28 | kbaxter@cppib.com
-- - Corrected filtering - moved the schedules to a CTE. The join and where conditions
--   were causing incorrect result set.
-- - Added the injections for the full table names to allow different environments
-- - Removed reference to ci_sentry_commtiments - funded_amount will come from ci_sentry_holdings.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.2.0 | 2025-05-21 | gstoffer@cppig.com
-- - Updated query to align with new holdings_staging schema
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

WITH

max_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(business_date) AS max_business_date
    FROM holdings_uat.ci_sentry_holdings
),

included_asset_types AS (
    SELECT 'Auto ABS'           AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Bond'               AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'CMBS'               AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'CLO Debt'           AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Construction Loan'  AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Convertible Bond'   AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Delayed Draw'       AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'External Debt'      AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'HRR Bond'           AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Loan'               AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'NPL'                AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Other ABS'          AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Revolver'           AS asset_type
),

included_seniority AS (
    SELECT '1st Lien'           AS seniority UNION
    SELECT '2nd Lien'           AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'ABS Debt'           AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'B-Note'             AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'CLO Debt'           AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'First Mortgage'     AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Hold Co/Pref'       AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Jr Sub'             AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Junior Mezzanine'   AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Mezzanine'          AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'RE Mezz'            AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Sr Secured'         AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Sr Subordinated'    AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Sr Unsecured'       AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Unitranche'         AS seniority
),

included_security_type AS (
    SELECT 'convertible'             AS sentry_security_type UNION

WITH
    listed_infra_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Infrastructure'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('MPINLCP1D','MINEON9','MINADP9','MINDNY9','MINCLNX','MINELET')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2025-05-11')
    )

    holding.business_date                                       AS "Business Date",
    sec.bloomberg_unique_id                                     AS "BB Unique ID - Current",

        ON holding.cppib_sec_id = CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
       AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date

  AND holding.cppib_sec_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY holding.business_date DESC,
         sec.bloomberg_unique_id

SELECT ctev.companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
            country, countrycode, city, region,
            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency,
            cf.period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency,
            investor_id, investor_name, ci.period_end_date as investment_period_end_date,
            percent_of_shares_outstanding as investor_percent_of_shares,
            rank_of_shares_held as investor_rank_of_shares_held
            FROM
            (-- Get company data +TEV
            SELECT companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
                            country, countrycode, city, region,
                            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
                            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency
            FROM
                (SELECT c.companyid, c.companyname, bd.business_description,
                                c.yearfounded, c.webpage,
                                ti.tickersymbol||':'||e.exchange_symbol AS ticker,
                                g.country, g.iso_country_2 AS countrycode, c.city, g.region,
                                c.simpleindustryid,
                                si.simple_industry_description AS simpleindustry,
                                mc.pricingdate,
                                max(pricingdate) over (PARTITION BY c.companyid) AS maxpricingdate,
                                mc.TEV, cur.isocode AS tev_currency
                            FROM capiq_company c
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_business_description bd ON
                                c.companyid = bd.company_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqsimpleindustry si ON
                                c.simpleindustryid = si.simple_industry_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqcountrygeo g ON c.countryid = g.country_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqMarketCap mc ON c.companyid = mc.companyid
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON mc.companyId=s.companyId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_exchange e ON e.exchange_id = ti.exchangeId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                            WHERE s.primaryFlag=1
                                AND ti.primaryFlag=1
                                AND simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                                AND companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating
                                                                -- 2=Operating Subsidiary
                                AND companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                                AND ((mc.TEV > 0 and cur.isocode is not null) OR mc.TEV IS NULL)
                                AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%9'
                )
            WHERE pricingdate=maxpricingdate
            ) AS ctev
            LEFT JOIN
            (-- Get LTM fundamentals for Public operating companies
            SELECT DISTINCT company_id,
                period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency
            FROM
                (SELECT f.company_id,
                    max(fiscal_chain_id) over (PARTITION BY f.company_id) AS maxfiscalchainid,
                    fiscal_chain_id,
                    max(period_end_date) over (PARTITION BY f.company_id) AS maxperiodenddate,
                    period_end_date,
                    CASE capiq_item_id
                        WHEN 112 THEN 'LTM_Revenue'
                        WHEN 4051 THEN 'LTM_EBITDA'
                    END AS capiq_item,
                    value_ltm, f.currency AS kpi_currency
                FROM cppib_party_fundamental_pit_capiq f
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_company c ON f.company_id = c.companyid
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON f.company_id=s.companyId
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                WHERE c.simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                    AND c.companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating 2=Operating Subsidiary
                    AND c.companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                    AND s.primaryFlag=1
                    AND ti.primaryFlag=1
                    AND f.pit_date = '2025-06-10'
                    AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%9'
                )
            WHERE period_end_date = maxperiodenddate AND
                fiscal_chain_id = maxfiscalchainid AND
                capiq_item IS NOT NULL
            ) AS cf
            ON ctev.companyid = cf.company_id
            LEFT JOIN
            (select company_id, company_name, investor_id, investor_name, period_end_date,
                    percent_of_shares_outstanding, rank_of_shares_held
            from (select o.company_id, c.companyname as company_name,
                        o.owner_object_id as investor_id,
                        i.companyname as investor_name, o.period_end_date,
                        o.percent_of_shares_outstanding,
                        o.rank_of_shares_held,
                        max(period_end_date) over (partition by o.company_id)
                        as max_period_end_date
                from cppib_party_ownership_pit_capiq o
                    left join capiq_company c on o.company_id = c.companyid
                    left join capiq_company i on o.owner_object_id = i.companyid
                where pit_date_str = '2025-06-10'
                    and o.is_latest_flag = 1
                    AND o.rank_of_shares_held IS NOT NULL
                    AND o.rank_of_shares_held <6
                    AND c.simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                    AND c.companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating 2=Operating Subsidiary
                    AND c.companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                    AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%9'
            )
        where period_end_date = max_period_end_date) AS ci
            ON ctev.companyid = ci.company_id

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 10
		AND hour between 13 and 14
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-10 13:51:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

with date_adjusted as (

        case
            when True and rm_name = 'cashRate' then date_add('day', 1, business_date)
            else business_date
        end as business_date_adj
    from market.tfm_risk_model_daily
    where business_date between date_add('day', -1, date '2025-05-26') and date '2025-05-26'
    and to_date(substring(cast(arrival_time as varchar), 1, 8), 'yyyymmdd') <= date '2025-12-31'
),
max_arrival_time as (
    select *,
        max(arrival_time) over (partition by rm_id, business_date_adj) as max_publish
    from date_adjusted
    where business_date_adj between date '2025-05-26' and date '2025-05-26'
)
select business_date, business_date_adj, rm_id, rm_value, rm_name
from max_arrival_time

	  calendar_date
	, fiscal_date
	, fiscal_year
	, fiscal_year_string
	, fiscal_quarter
	, fiscal_quarter_string
	, "month"
	, month_string
	, year_month
	, fiscal_year_string || '-' || fiscal_quarter_string as fiscal_year_quarter
	, case 
			when "month" > 3 then fiscal_year_string || '-0' || cast( "month" - 3 as varchar) || ' ' || month_string
			else fiscal_year_string || '-1' || cast( "month" - 1 as varchar) || ' ' || month_string
	  end fiscal_year_month
	, cost_type
	, stage
	, "view"
	, scenario
	, account_lvl_4
	, account_lvl_3 
	, account_lvl_2 
	, account_lvl_1 
	, account_lvl_0 
	, entity_lvl_2
	, entity_lvl_3
	, sending_entity_lvl_2
	, sending_entity_lvl_3
	, sending_entity_lvl_4
	, sending_entity_lvl_5
	, sending_entity_type
	, grouping_1 
	, grouping_2 
	, location_name
	, asset_liability_flag
	, value
from (
	select
		  calendar_date 
		, fiscal_date 
		, fiscal_year
		, 'FY' || substring( cast( fiscal_year as varchar ), 3, 2 ) as fiscal_year_string
		, fiscal_quarter 
		, format( 'Q%1$d', fiscal_quarter ) as fiscal_quarter_string
		, "month" 
		, format( '%1$tb', calendar_date ) as month_string
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', calendar_date ) as year_month
		, cost_type
		, stage
		, "view" 
		, scenario 
		, account_lvl_4
		, account_lvl_3 
		, account_lvl_2 
		, account_lvl_1 
		, account_lvl_0 
		, entity_lvl_2
		, entity_lvl_3
		, sending_entity_lvl_2
		, sending_entity_lvl_3
		, sending_entity_lvl_4
		, sending_entity_lvl_5
		, sending_entity_type
		, grouping_1 
		, grouping_2 
		, location_name 
		, asset_liability_flag
		, sum( amount ) as value
	from
		finance_accounting.vw_cost_insights_report
	where
		processed_datetime = ( select max(processed_datetime) from finance_accounting.vw_cost_insights_report )
		and fiscal_year >= 2019
		and grouping_1 is not null
	group by
		  calendar_date 
		, fiscal_date 
		, fiscal_year 
		, fiscal_quarter 
		, "month" 
		, cost_type
		, stage
		, "view" 
		, scenario 
		, account_lvl_4
		, account_lvl_3 
		, account_lvl_2 
		, account_lvl_1 
		, account_lvl_0 
		, entity_lvl_2
		, entity_lvl_3
		, sending_entity_lvl_2
		, sending_entity_lvl_3
		, sending_entity_lvl_4
		, sending_entity_lvl_5
		, sending_entity_type
		, grouping_1
		, grouping_2
		, location_name
		, asset_liability_flag
)) AS "cost_insights_report"

/* cppi::ddc919f0b4439e28b4e53f853da16b7acc76c7a4f7210413f45a507df27159ee */
SELECT
            from_currency as from_currency,
            to_currency as to_currency,
            ROUND(case
                when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price
                else mid_price
                end,6) as mid_price,
            business_date
        FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
        WHERE
            from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD'
            and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
            and business_date = Date('2025-06-10')
        UNION
        Select
            MainTable.to_currency as from_currency,
            'CAD' as to_currency,
            ROUND(case
                when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then
                MainTable.mid_price * CAD_Rate.mid_price
                else (1/MainTable.mid_price) * CAD_Rate.mid_price
                end,6) as calc_mid_price,
            MainTable.business_date
        FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr as MainTable
        Left Join
        (
            SELECT
                case
                when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price
                else mid_price
                end as mid_price,
                business_date
            FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
            WHERE from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD' and business_date = Date('2025-06-10')
            and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
        ) as CAD_Rate on
            MainTable.business_date = CAD_Rate.business_date
        WHERE
            MainTable.business_date = Date('2025-06-10')
            and MainTable.from_currency = 'USD'
            and MainTable.mid_price != 0
            and MainTable.source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
            order by business_date,from_currency

WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-08')                  AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE)) AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-08')
            AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
            AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_seg_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
            AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
            AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
            AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
            AND (
                        InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
                    AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                    AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                     OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0','MPR1000279','MPR1000328')
                )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,

	select
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel1 as investment_structure_level_01,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2 as investment_structure_level_02,
		uppcc.epm_party_name as ultimate_parent_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name as issuer_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name /*as "Exposure Via"*/,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name,
		sum( lt.total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
	from (
		select *
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
		where
			id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
			and id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
				  'MIN1000042'
				, 'NPTESTA'
				, 'NPTESTB'
				, 'PMIEMELTCS'
				, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
				, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
				, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
			) 
			and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough ) -- filter only for the data as of the latest business date
	) lt
	left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite secc
	on
		lt.enterprise_security_id = secc.enterprise_security_id
		and lt.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite pcc
	on
		secc.enterprise_party_id = pcc.enterprise_party_id
		and pcc.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite uppcc
	on
		pcc.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id = uppcc.enterprise_party_id
		and uppcc.business_date = pcc.business_date
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )

/* QuickSight 3b0d882f-4faf-476a-862d-ffdc068d4979 */
SELECT "business_date", "investment_structure_level_01", "investment_structure_level_02", "ultimate_parent_party_name", "issuer_name", "parent_security_type_name", "security_type_name", "security_name", "total_market_value_pc", "security_name_clean", "combined_entity_name_original", "combined_entity_name_clean", "department_sorted"
FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel1 as investment_structure_level_01,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2 as investment_structure_level_02,
		uppcc.epm_party_name as ultimate_parent_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name as issuer_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name /*as "Exposure Via"*/,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name,
		sum( lt.total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
	from (
		select *
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
		where
			id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
			and id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
				  'MIN1000042'
				, 'NPTESTA'
				, 'NPTESTB'
				, 'PMIEMELTCS'
				, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
				, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
				, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
			) 
			and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough ) -- filter only for the data as of the latest business date
	) lt
	left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite secc
	on
		lt.enterprise_security_id = secc.enterprise_security_id
		and lt.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite pcc
	on
		secc.enterprise_party_id = pcc.enterprise_party_id
		and pcc.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite uppcc
	on
		pcc.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id = uppcc.enterprise_party_id

/* QuickSight */
SELECT ds.* FROM ( with base as (
	select 
		  case
	  		when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and "level" = 0 then 'IPN_TF'
	  		else dataset_id
		  end dataset_id
		, business_date
		, "level"
		, case
			when dataset_id like '%_TF' or "dataset_id" in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) then 'Total Fund'	
			when dataset_id like '%_C' then 'Core'
			when dataset_id like '%_S' then 'Supplementary'
		  end node_name
		, case
			when metric like '%rc' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%lc' then 'Local'
			else 'FX'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%qtd%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%3m_roll%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%fytd%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%1y_roll%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%4yp%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5y_roll%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level" 
			, time_weighted_return_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			--, time_weighted_return_fx 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_qtd 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_fytd 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_4yp 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll 
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				  'MRP_TF'
				, 'RP_TF'
				, 'ATP_TF'
				, 'RISK_APP_TF'
				, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
				, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
				/* CORE POOL */
				, 'MRP_C'
				, 'RP_C'
				, 'ATP_C'
				, 'RISK_APP_C'
				, 'DIV_LVG_C'
				, 'INV_SELECT_C'
				/* SUPP POOL */
				, 'MRP_S'
				, 'RP_S'
				, 'ATP_S'
				, 'RISK_APP_S'
				, 'DIV_LVG_S'
				, 'INV_SELECT_S'
			)
			and "level" = 1
			and periods_per_year = 12 -- pull monthly values only
		union all
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level"
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local and FX values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_rc end time_weighted_return_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_lc end time_weighted_return_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx end time_weighted_return_fx
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_qtd_rc end time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_qtd_lc end time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_qtd end time_weighted_return_fx_qtd
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_rc end time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_lc end time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_fytd end time_weighted_return_fx_fytd
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_rc end time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_4yp end time_weighted_return_fx_4yp
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll
			, last_update
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
		where 
			(
				dataset_id in (
					/* CORE POOL */
					  'IPN_C'
					--, 'SAP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'IPN_S'
					--, 'SAP_S'
				)
				and node_id = '2'
			)
			or
			(	/* TOTAL FUND */
				dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
				and "level" = 0
			)
			and periods_per_year = 12 -- pull monthly values only
	) base_pivot
	cross join unnest(
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_lc'
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_qtd' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_lc'

					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'

					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'

					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)

							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined

	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final ) ds LIMIT 0

with cte as
(
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ISIN ORDER BY (CASE WHEN cppib_sec_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END), cppib_sec_id) AS rn
    from asset.asset_bonds
    where business_date = date'2025-06-09'
),
cmb as
(
    select
		id_cppib_security,
		maturity_bucket
	from (
		select distinct
			id_cppib_security,
			maturity_bucket,
			row_number() over (
				partition by id_cppib_security
				order by 
					case when feed_name like 'lbfi_%' then 1 else 2 end,
					cast(
						case
							when position('-' in maturity_bucket) > 1 then substr(maturity_bucket, 1, position('-' in maturity_bucket) - 1)
							else null
						end as integer
					) asc
			) as row_num
		from market.cppib_maturity_bucket
    	where business_date = date'2025-06-09' and maturity_bucket is not null and maturity_bucket != ''
	)
	where row_num = 1
)
select
    fsb.business_date,
    'IR_FSB_Benchmark' as benchmark_name,
    fsb."investment cell" as category,
    null as id_cppib_index,
    'tfm_bp_fsb_benchmark' as feed_name,
    fsb.indexID as index_name,
    cte.instrument_description as security_name,
    'Fixed Income' as asset_type,
    cte.sedol as sedol,
    cte.cusip as cusip,
    cte.isin as isin,
    ms.type,
    ms.sub_type,
    fsb.priceEOP as last_value_eod,
    fsb.priceEOP as last_value_ndo,
    fsb."benchmark weight" as weight_eod,
    fsb."benchmark weight" as weight_ndo,
    p.party_name as issuer_name,
    cte.cppib_sec_id as id_cppib_security,
    cte.currency_code as iso_currency_eod,
    cte.country_code as country_domicile,
    cte.listing_country_code as country_listing,
    cte.region_code as region,
    ms.cppib_market_capitalization_size_code as market_capitalization_size_code,
    cte.country_code as country_reference_code_eod,
    fsb."benchmark weight" as benchmark_constituent_weight,
    null as sub_component,
    sr.rating_value as security_rating,
    pr.rating_value as issuer_rating,
    null as developed_market_flag,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_code_1 as classification_code_1,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_name_1 as classification_code_1_description,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_code_2 as classification_code_2,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_name_2 as classification_code_2_description,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_code_3 as classification_code_3,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_name_3 as classification_code_3_description,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_code_4 as classification_code_4,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_name_4 as classification_code_4_description,
    null as alternate_listing,
    rc.country_name,
    fsb.mrktValue as market_capitalization_base_eod,
    null as investable_shares_eod,
    cte.trade_currency_code as iso_currency_local,
    null as quality,
    cmb.maturity_bucket as maturity_bucket
from market.tfm_bp_fsb_benchmark fsb
left join cte
    on fsb.business_date = cte.business_date and fsb.isin = cte.isin and cte.rn = 1
left join cmb
    on cte.cppib_sec_id = cmb.id_cppib_security
left join asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications ms
    on cte.cppib_sec_id = ms.cppib_sec_id and fsb.business_date = ms.business_date
left join asset.asset_security_ratings sr
    on cte.cppib_sec_id = sr.cppib_sec_id and fsb.business_date = sr.business_date and sr.rating_agency = 'CPPIB'
left join asset.asset_security_party_relationship spr
    on cte.cppib_sec_id = spr.cppib_sec_id and cte.business_date = spr.business_date and spr.role = 'ISSUER'
left join party.party p
    on spr.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id and fsb.business_date = p.business_date
left join party.party_ratings pr
    on spr.cppib_party_id = pr.cppib_party_id and fsb.business_date = pr.business_date and pr.rating_agency = 'CPPIB'
left join reference.reference_country_codes rc 
    on rc.country_code = cte.country_code and fsb.business_date = rc.business_date

    where is_breach = 'Y'

    union all

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 10
		AND hour between 14 and 15
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-10 14:31:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- This query retrieves holdings data and joins it with coupon and security-level
-- metadata. It filters the results based on selected asset types and seniorities,
-- and enriches each record with maturity dates and expected exit information.
-- The data is sourced as-of the latest available business date for accurate and
-- timely reporting.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Acronyms:
-- - ABS   : Asset-Backed Security
-- - CLO   : Collateralized Loan Obligation
-- - CMBS  : Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities
-- - NPL   : Non-Performing Loan
-- - HRR   : High-Risk Rated
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Data Lineage Summary:
-- - Holdings Source:       holdings_uat.ci_sentry_holdings
--                          (CI Sentry - current holdings data)
-- - Security Metadata:     reference.ci_sentry_security
--                          (Reference - asset type, seniority, etc.)
-- - Coupon Metadata:       reference.ci_sentry_security_coupon
--                          (Reference - maturity dates and coupon terms)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Parameters:
-- - business_date     : Latest business date available in ci_sentry_holdings.
-- - asset_type filter : Hardcoded list of included asset types.
-- - seniority filter  : Hardcoded list of included seniorities.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.0.0 | 2025-04-09 | kbaxter@cppib.com
-- - Initial creation: joins holdings with security and coupon metadata, includes
--   filters for asset type and seniority, and applies latest business date.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.1.0 | 2025-04-28 | kbaxter@cppib.com
-- - Corrected filtering - moved the schedules to a CTE. The join and where conditions
--   were causing incorrect result set.
-- - Added the injections for the full table names to allow different environments
-- - Removed reference to ci_sentry_commtiments - funded_amount will come from ci_sentry_holdings.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.2.0 | 2025-05-21 | gstoffer@cppig.com
-- - Updated query to align with new holdings_staging schema
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

WITH

max_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(business_date) AS max_business_date
    FROM holdings_uat.ci_sentry_holdings
),

included_asset_types AS (
    SELECT 'Auto ABS'           AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Bond'               AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'CMBS'               AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'CLO Debt'           AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Construction Loan'  AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Convertible Bond'   AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Delayed Draw'       AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'External Debt'      AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'HRR Bond'           AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Loan'               AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'NPL'                AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Other ABS'          AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Revolver'           AS asset_type
),

included_seniority AS (
    SELECT '1st Lien'           AS seniority UNION
    SELECT '2nd Lien'           AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'ABS Debt'           AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'B-Note'             AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'CLO Debt'           AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'First Mortgage'     AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Hold Co/Pref'       AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Jr Sub'             AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Junior Mezzanine'   AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Mezzanine'          AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'RE Mezz'            AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Sr Secured'         AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Sr Subordinated'    AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Sr Unsecured'       AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Unitranche'         AS seniority
),

included_security_type AS (
    SELECT 'convertible'             AS sentry_security_type UNION
    SELECT 'debt'                    AS sentry_security_type UNION
    SELECT 'delayedDrawLoanFacility' AS sentry_security_type UNION
    SELECT 'revolvingCreditFacility' AS sentry_security_type UNION
    SELECT 'termLoanFacility'        AS sentry_security_type
),

coupon_list AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT  -- Removes multiple loan contract records
        coupon.business_date,
        coupon.security_identifier,
        coupon.sentry_security_type,
        CASE
            WHEN coupon.sentry_security_type IN (
                'delayedDrawFacility',
                'revolvingCreditFacility',
                'termLoanFacility'
            ) THEN coupon.facility_maturity_date
            ELSE coupon.colc_maturity_date
        END AS maturity_date
    FROM reference_dev.ci_sentry_security_coupon AS coupon
    WHERE CAST(coupon.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-09' AS DATE)
),

schedule_list AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM reference_dev.ci_sentry_security_schedules
    WHERE schedule_name = 'Debt_Factor'
      AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-09' AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-09' AS DATE)
          BETWEEN CAST(start_date AS DATE) AND CAST(end_date AS DATE)
)

		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name

		select
			  business_date

				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'

			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig

		from (

				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em

				, external_reporting_country

				, year_month

				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from

			group by

				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS

			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )

FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, date_add( 'month', 9, mhl.business_date ) as fiscal_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mhl.external_reporting_region
		, mhl.external_reporting_country
		, mhl.external_reporting_assetmix
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name = unitization.pool_name
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
		and mhl.id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
			  'MIN1000042'
			, 'NPTESTA'
			, 'NPTESTB'
			, 'PMIEMELTCS'
			, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
			, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
			, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
		) 
		and mhl.business_date >= cast( '2019-03-31' as date ) -- only pull from F20 onwards because unitization data only goes back to 2018-10-01
), lt_final as (
	select
		  lt_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case 
			when business_date = ( max( business_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from business_date ), extract( month from business_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_month_end
		, case 
			when fiscal_date = ( max( fiscal_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from fiscal_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_fiscalyear_end
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'CHINA', 'HONG KONG', 'TAIWAN', 'MACAO' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'INDIA' then 'India'

			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'

			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case
			when currency_of_exposure_code in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
	from
		lt_base
), lt_final_agg as (
	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			--, lt_agg.fiscal_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0
)
select * from lt_final_agg) AS "holdings_lookthrough_new"

 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 10
		AND hour between 15 and 16
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-10 15:45:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT ctev.companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
            country, countrycode, city, region,
            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency,
            cf.period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency,
            investor_id, investor_name, ci.period_end_date as investment_period_end_date,
            percent_of_shares_outstanding as investor_percent_of_shares,
            rank_of_shares_held as investor_rank_of_shares_held
            FROM
            (-- Get company data +TEV
            SELECT companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
                            country, countrycode, city, region,
                            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
                            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency
            FROM
                (SELECT c.companyid, c.companyname, bd.business_description,
                                c.yearfounded, c.webpage,
                                ti.tickersymbol||':'||e.exchange_symbol AS ticker,
                                g.country, g.iso_country_2 AS countrycode, c.city, g.region,
                                c.simpleindustryid,
                                si.simple_industry_description AS simpleindustry,
                                mc.pricingdate,
                                max(pricingdate) over (PARTITION BY c.companyid) AS maxpricingdate,
                                mc.TEV, cur.isocode AS tev_currency
                            FROM capiq_company c
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_business_description bd ON
                                c.companyid = bd.company_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqsimpleindustry si ON
                                c.simpleindustryid = si.simple_industry_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqcountrygeo g ON c.countryid = g.country_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqMarketCap mc ON c.companyid = mc.companyid
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON mc.companyId=s.companyId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_exchange e ON e.exchange_id = ti.exchangeId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                            WHERE s.primaryFlag=1
                                AND ti.primaryFlag=1
                                AND simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                                AND companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating
                                                                -- 2=Operating Subsidiary
                                AND companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                                AND ((mc.TEV > 0 and cur.isocode is not null) OR mc.TEV IS NULL)
                                AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%4'
                )
            WHERE pricingdate=maxpricingdate
            ) AS ctev
            LEFT JOIN
            (-- Get LTM fundamentals for Public operating companies
            SELECT DISTINCT company_id,
                period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency
            FROM
                (SELECT f.company_id,

                    max(period_end_date) over (PARTITION BY f.company_id) AS maxperiodenddate,

SELECT
  business_date,
  CASE 
    WHEN adjusted_fx_currency IN ('USD','JPY','EUR','CNY','INR') THEN adjusted_fx_currency
    ELSE 'Other'
  END AS adjusted_fx_currency,
  SUM(market_value_cad) AS market_value_cad,
  SUM(market_value_cad_t_1) AS market_value_cad_t_1,
  SUM(cash_flow_cad) AS cash_flow_cad,
  ROUND(SUM(ROUND(pnl_cad, 2)), 2) AS pnl_cad,
  SUM(ROUND(pnl_local, 2)) AS pnl_local,
  SUM(ROUND(pnl_currency, 2)) AS pnl_currency,
  SUM(ROUND(pnl_currency_exposure_fx, 2)) AS pnl_currency_exposure_fx,
  SUM(ROUND(pnl_local_exposure_fx, 2)) AS pnl_local_exposure_fx,
  CASE 
    WHEN COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(ROUND(pnl_cad, 2)), 2) / NULLIF(SUM(market_value_cad_t_1), 0), 0) = -1 
      THEN 0 
    ELSE COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(ROUND(pnl_cad, 2)), 2) / NULLIF(SUM(market_value_cad_t_1), 0), 0) 
  END AS TWR_CAD,
  CASE 
    WHEN COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(ROUND(pnl_local_exposure_fx, 2)), 2) / NULLIF(SUM(market_value_cad_t_1), 0), 0) = -1 
      THEN 0 
    ELSE COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(ROUND(pnl_local_exposure_fx, 2)), 2) / NULLIF(SUM(market_value_cad_t_1), 0), 0) 
  END AS TWR_Local_Exposure_FX,
  (1 + 
    CASE 
      WHEN COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(ROUND(pnl_cad, 2)), 2) / NULLIF(SUM(market_value_cad_t_1), 0), 0) = -1 
        THEN 0 
      ELSE COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(ROUND(pnl_cad, 2)), 2) / NULLIF(SUM(market_value_cad_t_1), 0), 0) 
    END
  ) / (
    1 + 
    CASE 
      WHEN COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(ROUND(pnl_local_exposure_fx, 2)), 2) / NULLIF(SUM(market_value_cad_t_1), 0), 0) = -1 
        THEN 0 
      ELSE COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(ROUND(pnl_local_exposure_fx, 2)), 2) / NULLIF(SUM(market_value_cad_t_1), 0), 0) 
    END
  ) - 1 AS TWR_Currency_Adjusted_FX
FROM performance.pace_holding_pnl
WHERE performance_configuration_id = 'PC-POOLS'
  AND model_portfolio_code IS NOT NULL
  AND component_type NOT IN (
    'Cash',
    'Spot',
    'Constituent from original',
    'Constituent from spot',
    'Constituent from generic decomposition',
    'Residual from generic decomposition'
  )
  AND cash_state NOT IN ('Settled cash', 'Unsettled cash')
  AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-04-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
GROUP BY business_date,
  CASE 
    WHEN adjusted_fx_currency IN ('USD','JPY','EUR','CNY','INR') THEN adjusted_fx_currency
    ELSE 'Other'
  END
LIMIT 400

WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-06')                  AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE)) AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-06')
            AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
            AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_seg_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
            AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
            AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
            AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
            AND (
                        InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
                    AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                    AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                     OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0','MPR1000279','MPR1000328')
                )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_seg_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings_uat.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code

       AND perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_3 = perf_data.bloomberg_code
       AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = DATE('2025-06-06')
ORDER BY perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id,
         perf_data.bloomberg_code

/* cppi::54715f6cd94f29ba5dc9b5139f33903e9ee6e62718616806ba6220a4b4f57511 */
WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-09')                  AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE)) AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-09')
            AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
            AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_seg_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
            AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
            AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
            AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
            AND (
                        InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
                    AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                    AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                     OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0','MPR1000279','MPR1000328')
                )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_seg_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings_uat.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

SELECT
    (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)                    AS "Start Date",
    perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id                           AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    perf_data.security_name                                 AS "Security Name - Current",
    perf_data.bloomberg_code                                AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    perf_data.model_portfolio                               AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_start                         AS "Total Market Value QC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow QC",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_end                           AS "Total Market Value QC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency  AS "Total PnL QC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_start                         AS "Total Market Value PC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow PC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_end                           AS "Total Market Value PC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency - perf_seclvl.period_result_node_by_node_local AS "FX PnL PC",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency  AS "Total PnL PC"
FROM perf_data
INNER JOIN performance_uat.scd_performance_seclvl perf_seclvl
        ON perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_1 = perf_data.model_portfolio
       AND perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_3 = perf_data.bloomberg_code
       AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = DATE('2025-06-09')
ORDER BY perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id,
         perf_data.bloomberg_code
